description:
A run as it is asked for: the document and the options that steer it.

The base of the relative paths and the environment of the call are not part
of it, so the request is the same on any machine.

config.description: The whole configuration document: a TOML file and its base_config chain and overlays merged, or the document given as JSON or as a dict. It names no base_config and no [workspace] project_root.
config.title: Config

set.description: Values set on top of config by dotted path, the grammar of --set, applied once at the load and sealed in lineage.overrides.
set.title: Set

overlays.description: The names of the overlay files merged into config, for lineage.overrides.
overlays.title: Overlays

name.description: The name of the run, which wins.
name.title: Name

resume.description: The run to continue in place; an empty text names the run of the request.
resume.title: Resume

from_step.description: First step of a partial run.
from_step.title: From Step

until_step.description: Last step of a partial run.
until_step.title: Until Step

force.description: Compute a run identical to a completed one.
force.title: Force

fresh.description: File what a previous attempt left and start over.
fresh.title: Fresh

dry_run.description: Say what would run, and run nothing.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

no_display.description: Draw no figure. It changes neither the identity nor the seal.
no_display.title: No Display

phase.description: The one phase of a staged calibration to run.
phase.title: Phase

source.description: The file the request was read from, relative to the base when it lies under it.
source.title: Source

form.description: What the request was built from; json and dict write request.json.
form.title: Form

title: RunRequest
